Jira comments after application clarify that Dispense could not be changed and the WG agreed the applied result was correct.

No MedicationDispense source change was made.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes MedicationRequest and MedicationDispense, records MedicationRequest.effectiveTiming[x] as an R6 addition, and maps MedicationRequest.effectiveDosePeriod to it as a rename. Pharmacy Confluence notes record the initial persuasive decision and the later vote acknowledging that MedicationDispense has no effectiveTiming element, so the resolution was applied only to MedicationRequest. A stale checked-in MedicationRequest SVG still references effectiveDosePeriod, but it is generated-looking/non-authoritative and was not edited as the only remaining artifact.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The combined branch authoritative MedicationRequest StructureDefinition already implements the accepted change, and MedicationDispense correctly remains unchanged under the later WG clarification.
